method: Machine comparison of two independent BigInt bytes reverifications of the 16 cost73j WIN7-D10 certificates (class2-lane-cost73j). Lane A: reverification JSON published to main by a concurrent lane (fetched from main raw, pin.commit 8803a3b01ef5932a246ead2f67f31b1438c768ac). Lane B: this lane's independent reverification JSON (separately written verifier, separate mirror fetched from the same band at pin commit 6758f03e485c6896d5101d3a4d31bc59fb9537e9). All 16 entries compared field-by-field on the 36 common scalar fields plus the nested per-part pin blocks (pinned_blob_sha and bytes for each split part).

lane_a.source: main raw fetch of the published reverification JSON

lane_b.source: this lane's local independent reverification (script reverify_cost73j_certificates_bigint_20261117.py, run twice byte-identical)

interpretation_guard: This agreement record concerns only the independent reproducibility of the cost73j certificate reverification (16 seven-stone roots, depth-10 subtree proof of first-player win). It does not decide the 11x11 empty board or any two-stone root; the 11x11 game value remains UNKNOWN. REFUTED-D10 is not a LOSS proof at any larger scope.
